Our Mission

Why we exist

Our mission is to bridge the gap between the autism community and the communities in which they live. We do this by fostering trust through our first responder programs, reducing the employment gap through workforce development, and building confidence through our self-reliance initiatives.

Trust

Built face-to-face with local police, fire, and EMS through community events where families and first responders get to know each other outside of an emergency.

First Responder Programs

Employer & Corporate Partners

Live and virtual workplace trainings built for employers and businesses that employ and/or serve individuals with autism.

Workforce Development

Career Readiness

Workshops and hands-on training to build the skills and confidence to find and keep success in the workplace.

Workforce Development

Confidence

Earned through skills, routine, and real-world practice, so self-reliance becomes something every person we serve can count on.

Self-Reliance
First Responder Programs

Where trust gets built

A recurring event that brings the autism community and local police together in a low-pressure, welcoming setting. No sirens, no stress, just familiar faces. More events are on the way.

Pancakes with Police

A relaxed breakfast where local police officers sit down with autistic children and their families, badges off duty and pancakes on the table.

Our Story

Who we are

Cool 2 Care started the day we learned our son, Bo, was diagnosed with autism. We just didn't know it yet. That diagnosis opened up a world we didn't know yet, the world of disabilities. Like most families in this position, we spent countless hours and late nights researching, reading, and trying to understand what our son actually needed from us.

As his father, I'll admit something I'm not proud of. I spent time trying to shape Bo into the son I'd always pictured growing up, instead of becoming the father he actually needed me to be. It took time, but I learned that lesson, and it changed how I showed up for him every day after. I am trying to be the father he needs me to be.

That lesson became undeniable one morning when Bo fell and was knocked unconscious. We called 911, frantic, watching him lie motionless on the ground. Word must have spread fast, because nearly every first responder in the area showed up. They did an incredible job. Their only focus was making sure Bo was okay, and he was. But in the middle of that emergency, we saw something else too: a real gap between the autism community and the first responders who show up on the worst days.

After Bo got the care he needed at the hospital, we took a step back. That morning had changed something in us. I wanted to make sure Bo was prepared for every future moment he'd spend with a first responder. I wanted him to know, without question, that first responders are the good guys, that in the moment he needs people the most, he can rely on them completely. That's when Cool 2 Care was born.

Our mission is to bridge the gap between the autism community and the communities in which they live, and we do that by fostering trust. We're so glad you're here, and we hope you'll become part of our story at Cool 2 Care.

It's cool to care about autism.
